findings.evidence: docs/technology-context.md Summary states as fact: "It is deployed on the Vercel platform (`README.md`, \"Deploy on Vercel\" section)." This directly contradicts overview.md's own hedged claim on the same fact, and technology-context.md's own later Deployment Platform section ("[NEEDS CLARIFICATION] Whether this project is actually deployed to Vercel in practice ... cannot be confirmed") is also inconsistent with its own Summary.
findings.locationHint: `README.md`'s "Deploy on Vercel" section is unmodified `create-next-app` boilerplate text ("The easiest way to deploy your Next.js app is to use the Vercel Platform") and does not confirm that finance-planner is actually deployed on Vercel or describe any project-specific hosting configuration.
findings.message: docs/overview.md correctly hedges that Vercel deployment is unconfirmed, but the sibling doc docs/technology-context.md states in its Summary as a flat fact that the application "is deployed on the Vercel platform" - the two generated docs make contradictory claims about the same fact.
